thread:
DesignLead: thinking about regrouping the left rail — we keep getting requests to surface 'Model routes' and 'Deployment configs' nearer to the top. proposing we collapse current 7 items into 4 clusters: Models, Deploy, Observability, Admin. quick thoughts? :thinking_face:
ProductPM: +1 on collapsing, but worried about discoverability for power users who expect the old ordering. can we keep permalinks for deep links?
FrontendEng: we can preserve deep links with redirects. suggestion: keep old routes but add new canonical paths, and show a small migration banner for a few weeks.
EngRouter: routing nit — if we alias old URLs to new ones we should avoid 302s for SEO/analytics noise, use 301-ish server-side rewrites where possible. also: need to confirm how breadcrumbs map to clusters.
DesignLead: breadcrumb mapping is tricky. current breadcrumbs show workspace > resource > subpage. with clustering we'd have one extra indirection. proposal: breadcrumbs should show cluster > item > subpage, so users see cluster context.
Accessibility: ensure cluster headers are actual headings (h2/h3) for screen reader navigation. also keyboard jump links to top-level clusters are helpful.
UXResearch: ran 6 quick tests — users scanned for 'Deploy' and missed it when it was nested under infra. clustering helped, but label copy matters. recommended label: 'Deployments' instead of 'Deploy' (more descriptive).
FrontendEng: small implementation detail — prefer `nav-group` aria attributes and `aria-current` for active items. will add focus ring tweaks.
ProductPM: about deep links: we need a compatibility window and a metrics flag. DevExBot: created ticket RDW-1253 to add route aliases + migration banner.
EngRouter: example route mapping I sketched:
```
/old/workspaces/:id/infrastructure/deploy -> /workspaces/:id/deployments
/models/:modelId -> /models/:modelId (no change)
/old/models -> /models/catalog (canonical)
```
If we do rewrites server-side, we should also record the original path in analytics for 6 weeks.
DesignLead: decisions so far: 1) group into 4 clusters 2) canonicalize new paths and alias old ones 3) breadcrumbs show cluster context 4) add migration banner + metrics flag 5) accessibility TODOs per Accessibility notes. can someone add a small mock for the cluster headers and new breadcrumb flow?
FrontendEng: I'll mock HTML/CSS and drop into the design board by EOD. will include keyboard nav and aria attributes.
UXResearch: I'll schedule a 5-person validation session next week to confirm labels and discoverability.
Accessibility: will run the header/skip-link checks and send a short a11y checklist.
ProductPM: also confirm with Legal if any copy changes for admin pages.
DesignLead: cool — thanks everyone. follow-ups: FrontendEng to mock, UXResearch validation, DevExBot ticket RDW-1253 for routing. we'll revisit after validation. :white_check_mark:
